summary: Willis Lease Finance Corp filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a registered short-sale of common stock by Morgan Stanley to facilitate hedging for convertible arbitrage investors. Concurrently, the company is offering $175M of 0% convertible senior notes due 2031 (plus $25M overallotment). The short-sale shares are borrowed from third parties; the company receives no proceeds. The structure links the equity offering to the convertible note issuance. The completion of each offering is contingent on the other. Watch for final pricing, conversion premium, and the extent of arbitrage investor hedging. Risk-arb: focus on note pricing and equity hedge dynamics.
